notes: Talent trees: every class now has three WoW-style spec trees (7 tiers, multi-rank talents, prerequisites and a capstone)
All your old talent points come back unspent, and the class level cap rises to 51 (1 talent point per level)
Respec any time: Reset, then Apply; leaving with unapplied points asks Apply or Discard
Talents work with touch (swipe or pinch between trees), mouse and keyboard, and controller (LB/RB switch trees, X removes)
New skill for every class: Umbral Double, Locust Swarm, Soul Wraiths, Hunter's Snare, Soul Chains, Nebula Spiral, Wild Stampede and Prismatic Comet
New form skills: Moonclaw Whirl (Cat Form, melee) and Uprooted Boulder (Tree Form)
Every new skill has its own evolution (see the Codex), shows in the damage meter and follows the obstacle rules
Download for Windows now gets the v2.0.0 installer
